readings.title: The Premial Blessings of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Restoring the Kosmos Through His Compassion
readings.text: [Psalm 103:1] Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O my being, And all that is within me, Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> set-apart Name! [2] Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O my being, And do not forget all <dn>His</dn> dealings, [3] Who forgives all your crookednesses, Who heals all your diseases, [4] Who redeems your life from destruction, Who crowns you with loving-commitment and compassion, [5] Who satisfies your desire with the good, Your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

readings.title: Tsedek and the Revelation of His Ways
readings.subtitle: Absolute Justice Tempered with Infinite Patience
readings.text: [Psalm 103:6] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is doing righteousness And right-ruling for all the oppressed. [7] <dn>He</dn> made known <dn>His</dn> ways to Mosheh, <dn>His</dn> acts to the children of Yisra’ĕl. [8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is compassionate and showing favour, Patient, and great in loving-commitment. [9] <dn>He</dn> does not always strive, nor maintain it forever.

readings.title: Atonement for the Dust of the Earth
readings.subtitle: The Father's Covering for Human Frailty
readings.text: [Psalm 103:10] <dn>He</dn> has not done to us according to our sins, Nor rewarded us according to our crookednesses. [11] For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment toward those who fear <dn>Him</dn>; [12] As far as east is from west, So far has <dn>He</dn> removed our transgressions from us. [13] As a father has compassion for his children, So <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has compassion for those who fear <dn>Him</dn>. [14] For <dn>He</dn> knows how we are made; <dn>He</dn> remembers that we are dust.

readings.title: The Oath of the Eternal Covenant
readings.subtitle: The Prerequisite of Guarding His Orders
readings.text: [Psalm 103:15] A man’s days are like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes. [16] For the wind blows over it, and it is no more, And its place no longer remembers it. [17] But the loving-commitment of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> Is from everlasting to everlasting Upon those who fear <dn>Him</dn>, And <dn>His</dn> righteousness to children’s children, [18] To those who guard <dn>His</dn> covenant, And to those who remember <dn>His</dn> orders to do them.

readings.title: The Universal Reign of the Creator
readings.subtitle: Messengers of the Divine State Exalting His Name
readings.text: [Psalm 103:19] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has established <dn>His</dn> throne in the heavens, And <dn>His</dn> reign shall rule over all. [20] Bless <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you <dn>His</dn> messengers, Mighty in power, who do <dn>His</dn> Word, Listening to the voice of <dn>His</dn> Word. [21] Bless <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all you <dn>His</dn> hosts, You <dn>His</dn> servants, who do <dn>His</dn> pleasure. [22] Bless <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all <dn>His</dn> works, In all places of <dn>His</dn> rule. Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O my being!

readings.subsection: A Song, a Psalm of Daviḏ
readings.title: A Steadfast Heart in the Face of Conflict
readings.subtitle: Invoking the Heavy Weight of Kavod
readings.text: [Psalm 108:1] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, my heart is steadfast; I sing and give praise – even my esteem. [2] Awake, harp and lyre! I awake the dawn. [3] I praise <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, among peoples, And I sing praises to <dn>You</dn> among the nations. [4] For <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment is great above the heavens, And <dn>Your</dn> truth reaches to the clouds. [5] Exalt <dn>Yourself</dn> above the heavens, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, And <dn>Your</dn> esteem above all the earth; [6] In order that those <dn>You</dn> love Might be delivered. Save with <dn>Your</dn> right hand, And answer me.

readings.subsection: A Song, a Psalm of Daviḏ
readings.title: The Divine Measure and Territorial Dominion
readings.subtitle: Establishing the Geometric Reality of Authority
readings.text: [Psalm 108:7] <dn>Elohim</dn> has spoken in <dn>His</dn> set-apartness, <dq><dn>I</dn> exult, <dn>I</dn> portion out Sheḵem, And <dn>I</dn> measure out the Valley of Sukkoth.</dq> [8] <dq>Gil‘aḏ is <dn>Mine</dn>, Menashsheh is <dn>Mine</dn>, And Ephrayim is <dn>My</dn> chief defence, Yehuḏah is <dn>My</dn> inscriber.</dq> [9] <dq>Mo’aḇ is <dn>My</dn> wash-pot, Over Eḏom <dn>I</dn> cast <dn>My</dn> shoe, Over Philistia <dn>I</dn> raise a shout.”</dq>

readings.subsection: A Song, a Psalm of Daviḏ
readings.title: The Impossibility of Human Deliverance
readings.subtitle: Overcoming Exclusively Through the Power of Elohim
readings.text: [Psalm 108:10] Who would bring me into the strong city? Who shall lead me to Eḏom? [11] Have <dn>You</dn> not rejected us, O <dn>Elohim</dn>? And <dn>You</dn> do not go out with our armies, O <dn>Elohim</dn>! [12] Give us help from distress, For the help of man is naught. [13] In <dn>Elohim</dn> we do mightily, For it is <dn>He</dn> who treads down our adversaries.

readings.title: The Blueprint of Retributive Friction
readings.subtitle: The Accuser Repays Harmony with Hatred
readings.text: [Psalm 109:1] Do not be silent, O <dn>Elohim</dn> of my praise! [2] For the mouth of the wrong And the mouth of the deceiver Have opened against me; They have spoken against me with a false tongue. [3] They have surrounded me with words of hatred, And they attack me without a cause. [4] In return for my love they accuse me, While I am in prayer. [5] And they repay me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

readings.title: The Imprecatory Verdict on the Deceiver
readings.subtitle: The Complete Eradication of the Rebel's Authority
readings.text: [Psalm 109:6] Appoint over him one who is wrong, And let an accuser stand at his right hand. [7] When he is judged, let him be found wrong, And let his prayer become sin. [8] Let his days be few, Let another take his office. [9] Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow. [10] And let his children always wander and beg, And seek food out of their ruins. [11] Let the creditor lay a snare for all that he has, And let strangers plunder his labour. [12] Let him have no one to extend loving-commitment, Nor any to show favour to his fatherless children. [13] Let his descendants be cut off, Their name be blotted out in the next generation. [14] Let the crookedness of his fathers Be remembered before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out. [15] Let them always be before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And let <dn>Him</dn> cut off their remembrance from the earth;

readings.title: The Inevitable Consequences of Ra
readings.subtitle: Consuming the Toxic Harvest of One's Own Design
readings.text: [Psalm 109:16] Because he did not remember to show loving-commitment, But persecuted the poor and needy man; And the broken-hearted, to put to death. [17] He also loved cursing, so let it come to him; And he did not delight in blessing, so let it be far from him. [18] And he put cursing on as with his garment, So let it enter his inward parts like water, Into his bones and like oil. [19] Let it be to him like a cloak he wraps around him, And as a girdle that he always girds on. [20] This is the reward of my accusers from <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And to those speaking evil against my being.

readings.title: The Crushing Weight of the Human Trial
readings.subtitle: Operating Under the Veil of the Hidden Face
readings.text: [Psalm 109:21] But <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Master, Deal with <dn>את</dn> me for <dn>Your</dn> Name’s sake; Because <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment is good, deliver me. [22] For I am poor and needy, And my heart is pierced within me. [23] I have gone like a lengthening shadow, I have been driven away like a locust. [24] My knees are weak through fasting, And my flesh grows lean from fatness. [25] And I, I have become a reproach to them; They see me, they shake their heads.

readings.title: Vindication by the Right Arm
readings.subtitle: The Lifted Face Rescues the Needy from False Judgment
readings.text: [Psalm 109:26] Help me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn>! Save me according to <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, [27] And let them know that this is <dn>Your</dn> hand. <dn>You</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have done it! [28] Let them curse, but <dn>You</dn> bless. They shall arise, but be ashamed, And let <dn>Your</dn> servant rejoice. [29] Let my accusers put on shame, And be wrapped in their own confusion as in a cloak. [30] I greatly thank <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with my mouth, And I praise <dn>Him</dn> in the midst of the throng. [31] For <dn>He</dn> stands at the right hand of the poor, To save from those judging his being.

readings.title: The Authority of the Right Arm
readings.subtitle: The Execution of Power from the Center of Tsiyon
readings.text: [Psalm 110:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to my Master, <dq>“Sit at <dn>My</dn> right hand, Until <dn>I</dn> make <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> enemies a footstool for <dn>Your</dn> feet.”</dq> [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> sends <dn>Your</dn> mighty sceptre out of Tsiyon. Rule in the midst of <dn>Your</dn> enemies! [3] <dn>Your</dn> people volunteer in the day of <dn>Your</dn> might, In the splendours of set-apartness! From the womb, from the morning, <dn>You</dn> have the dew of <dn>Your</dn> youth!

readings.title: The Immutable Oath of the Creator
readings.subtitle: The Eternal Order of Malkitseḏeq
readings.text: [Psalm 110:4] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has sworn and does not relent, <dq>“<dn>You</dn> are a priest forever According to the order of Malkitseḏeq.”</dq>

readings.title: The Ultimate Rebalancing of the Kosmos
readings.subtitle: The Right Arm Crushes the Adversarial Architecture
readings.text: [Psalm 110:5] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at <dn>Your</dn> right hand Shall smite sovereigns in the day of <dn>His</dn> wrath. [6] <dn>He</dn> judges among the nations, <dn>He</dn> shall fill the nations with dead bodies, <dn>He</dn> shall crush the Head over the mighty earth! [7] <dn>He</dn> drinks of the stream by the wayside, Therefore <dn>He</dn> does lift up the head!

readings.title: The Geographic Crucible of Right-Ruling
readings.subtitle: The Unified Structure of the Divine Administration
readings.text: [Psalm 122:1] I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go into the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” [2] Our feet have been standing Within your gates, O Yerushalayim! [3] Yerushalayim is built As a city that is bound together, [4] Where the tribes have come up, The tribes of Yah, A witness to Yisra’ĕl, To give thanks to the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [5] For there the thrones of right-ruling were set, The thrones of the house of Daviḏ.

readings.title: The Mandate for Tov in Yerushalayim
readings.subtitle: Prioritizing the Absolute Peace of the Appointed City
readings.text: [Psalm 122:6] Pray for the peace of Yerushalayim, Let those who love you be at rest. [7] Peace be within your walls, Rest in your citadels. [8] For the sake of my brothers and companions, I say, “Peace be within you.” [9] For the sake of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> I seek your good.

readings.title: The Overwhelming Surge of Adversity
readings.subtitle: The Vulnerability of Existence Outside the Hedge
readings.text: [Psalm 124:1] “If it had not been <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who was on our side,” Let Yisra’ĕl now say; [2] “If it had not been <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who was on our side, When men rose up against us, [3] “Then they would have swallowed us alive, In their burning rage against us; [4] “Then the waters would have overwhelmed us, The stream would have gone over our being; [5] “Then the proud waters Would have gone over our being.”

readings.title: Deliverance from the Demonic Snare
readings.subtitle: Total Reliance on the Creator of the Physical Sphere
readings.text: [Psalm 124:6] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Who did not give us as prey to their teeth. [7] Our being has escaped like a bird From the snare of the trappers; The snare was broken, and we have escaped. [8] Our help is in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Maker of the heavens and earth.
